title: Trader Diary: 84k Dip Drama
content: Saw BTC slide 2% at 3 AM -> opened a 20x long because 'this is my entry'. 5 min later I'm Googling 'how to survive a margin call'.
lesson: Never let FOMO dictate position size—set your stop‑loss before you click confirm.
question: Who else turned a 2% dip into a heart‑rate test? Share your worst FOMO story 👇
